dialogue.line: This place is fucking with your head
because it knows how much you miss your dad!
I watched you have two seizures in two days.
You're only angry at me right now because you know I'm right.
When I found Mom out by the Bottle Tree, I saw him.
I think I've seen them before.
I remembered how to hurt them.
I think the mushrooms kicked in.
Show me what I used to know.
It's me. When I was 12 years-old.
This is where the children were sacrificed.
Tell me how we save them when we've already failed!
How the fuck did we get here?
I know what we have to do to go home.
I know how we can save the children.
I am telling you it is the only way.
To what? To get everyone killed?
You wanna go into those tunnels
where those things live, because you think the bones
of those children are buried down there?
Listen, I-- I understand that this all seems a little shaky--
Is that how you'd describe this, a little shaky?
We knew going into this, it was an out-of-the-box swing.
If you're just gonna flatly reject everything I found
based on how I found it,
then what the fuck did I even do this for?
Let's just forget for a second that you saw all this
during a mushroom-infused fever dream, let's just...
...let's just put that aside for a second.
and the bones are down there...
How does finding bones help us go home?
there are countless examples throughout history
of cultures, of religions that hold the remains--
the remains of the deceased-- in great reverence.
What do you think the Egyptians mummified their rulers for?
This place, this fucking nightmare that we are stuck in,
are what anchor the spirits of those children here?
I mean, have you ever wondered why those creatures
never come out of the tunnels during the day?
What if they're down there protecting the very thing
Which brings me back to the part where you get everyone killed.
Nah. Not if we do it right.
Tell me what the right version of this plan looks like.
Well, I mean, that's sort of where you come in.
Look, I realize that there are a lot of things in your head
right now that may turn out to be really important.
But look at it from where I'm standing.
You want me to help plan a suicide mission
because of some things that you saw in a mushroom trip!
What do I have to do,
what do I have to do to prove to you this is real?
You and I went into the basement in Colony House.
I already told you, we didn't go anywhere.
And I've never been inside the basement at Colony House
so I would have no way of knowing
what it looks like down there.
Jade, describing the basement of Colony House
Do you remember seeing any doors
in the basement of Colony House?
what I'm telling you about these bones is true?
Come on. Here you go. All right.
Explain to me why this was fun for your generation?
It's like social media from the Stone Age.
This is it! This, this is the basement I saw.
Yeah, we're trying to build a narrative
for the people that came before us.
Boyd's just trying to keep me busy
because he knows that I want to kill myself.
I haven't slit my wrists yet.
I'm looking for a secret door that I saw
while I was on mushrooms I found in the forest.
Just gimme a hand! Come on!
No, no, no. No, no, no. It's supposed to be here.
Everything else-- Everything else is exactly the same!
Maybe the door-- Maybe... maybe it's just a metaphor.
Maybe the bones were a metaphor.
I understand that you have doubts.
Okay, if the situation were reversed, I'd have doubts too.
And I realize what I'm suggesting is incredibly risky--
What, we lose a couple of people?
Maybe a dozen? How many is too many, Jade?
How many people are gonna die if you keep
sitting on your goddamn hands doing nothing?
How many have you already lost, huh?
What the fuck did you say to me?
Say it again! Go ahead! Say it again!
Boyd, there is only so long
that you can hold this place together
At some point, something's gonna give.
You're gonna lose this whole fucking town.
I went looking for answers and I found answers.
So, Jade thinks that digging up these bones
is gonna somehow help us get home?
If the bones are even down there in the first place, yeah.
And Jade and Tabitha have these memories because...
If you'd asked me before I got worms under my skin,
or before I found magic rocks in the forest
that protect us from monsters, what the--
I wasn't tryin' to keep any of this from you.
I know, I know, I know.
And I know things haven't exactly been quiet lately.
Remember the good old days when we used to count the nights
If you'd have told me that was the good part--
There is something else we need to talk about.
Oh my God, what's he doing?
What are you doing up here?
When I was a boy, a man jumped from here.
He hated this place so much,
and he was so scared all the time, so one day he jumped.
It took days for him to finally die.
He was trying to fix things but he just made them worse.
Are you here because of what I told my dad?
I shouldn't have told him any of that.
he came here just like everybody else.
Is there anything else you can remember about him?
I wanted to do something nice for Sophia.
Make her feel more at home.
Nathan always used to say, "A fresh coat of paint
I-- I don't know what color's in the cans.
Uh, look, I just wanted to say I'm sorry.
I didn't really understand what you went through.
But I think I do now.
Yeah. Just wanted to say sorry.
I have an extra brush. Come on inside.
you told your dad he came to town
We thought his suit was funny.
He seemed like a nice man.
Was he alone when he came here?
I don't know, I'm not sure.
Do you remember what kind of car he came in?
It was big. It was brown.
Is that one of the cars you took out to the woods?
I didn't want to see it.
Hey. You think you could go out there with us,
and show us which one it is?
I'm not gonna make you do anything
that you don't wanna do, okay?
We just need to get as much information as we can.
We need to find out if this guy, this man--
whatever he is-- if it's something
Just trying to keep everybody safe.
Will you help me do that?
Hey. What are you doing back so soon?
Uh, you need to come down to the shed.
Yeah. He's up in his room.
He's fine. He went inside to check on Fatima.
Patty's down at the clinic. She got pretty banged up.
The fuck Donna. Who is that?
I don't know how else to say this,
so I'm just gonna say it.
We were attacked by giant dolls that came out of the lake.
And these are not just decorative.
Tabitha used it to kill one of the dolls.
Drove it right through the fucker.
that was after they got a hold of Roger.
We found his body this morning.
We left some food back up at the settlement
so we could bring back the totems.
We figured they'd be worth more than a few bags of turnips.
Anybody need a drink? 'Cause I need a drink.
It's just a lot to take in.
After everything that this place has done to you,
with everything that this place is still doing to you,
I just don't understand what's happening, okay?
And I just-- I feel like there is just so much more
that I should be doing to help.
And I feel-- I feel like I am the one that's failing here.
That's-- And I'm not just-- I'm not just saying that
growing up, there were a lot of times
A lot of times when I felt powerless.
But those stories, about the Jinn,
Vishnu and Krishna, the Golem of Prague...
I understand now why my father told me those stories.
The world was so fucking scary,
but if I could believe in magical things,
then that was something no one could ever take away.
Look, we have seen so much darkness.
We've lived with so much fear.
I need to believe in magical things.
Is this about the suit we found in the forest?
Why did you get so scared?
I don't want to tell you that.
he got-- he got really upset.
I just told you I don't want to tell you that!
Well then, I guess I'm not gonna tell you
The lake had monsters in it.
What did-- What did your Mom do?
Your mom's-- Your mom's pretty tough.
Well, my mom was pretty tough too.
You know, she was always-- she always smiled, even--
Because she knew that we would be scared if she didn't.
I don't think my dad's that strong.
Excuse me? Have you seen the Sheriff?
Try up at Colony House maybe.
Well, it's been a bit of a day.
Why is there a bar inside of a gas station?
Better question is, why is there a gas station
in a town where no one can leave?
there used to be a bartender here.
Do you mind if I join you?
I'm sorry; I didn't mean to bother you.
I didn't-- I didn't mean to be rude.
It's kind of amazing that anyone here has the capacity
Here's to the resiliency of the human spirit.
Old enough to have buried my dad.
All right, so you're saying that those things
I'm sorry, I'm sorry. What are you saying?
The man who took them from me was afraid of them.
He said they gave him nightmares.
So he threw them in the lake.
But then, when the man died...
Our fears become part of the forest.
When the cicadas were all over town,
Sara told me Nathan had always been terrified of them.
She thought that maybe the people who die here,
How are we gonna tell people?
How are we gonna tell them that they not only
have to worry about those smiling pieces of shit
but now we have literal fucking nightmares
that we can't even protect them from!
How much more can people take before they just--
Why don't you just have a seat?
No, look. I just need to splash some water on my face.
Donna! Oh, oh, hey, Donna! Donna! Donna, Donna?
Donna, talk to me! Donna, talk to me!
Donna! Hey, do you know how to check for a pulse?
But it's gonna keep it nice and clean, okay?
I know, I'm sorry. Just breathe.
Oh, I know. You're doing great. Good.
Okay. Just breathe. I know. Just breathe.
Kristi! Donna had a heart attack!
Come on, Donna, stay with me!
Hey, watch out! Clear the way! Back up!
Five, seven minutes, I don't know.
Okay. You started compressions right away?
Boyd. Boyd, it's not gonna work.
I said, hit her again! Hey!
You don't die until I say you die! You hear me?
You don't die until I say you die!
What was that? Did you see that?
Her pulse is back. It's weak, but it's back.
Donna? Hey! Donna, can you hear me?
Is she okay? Why isn't she--
I don't know, but we need the monitor from the ambulance.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. I got it.
How are we gonna power them up here?
Power it? Just don't worry about that.
I'll take care of that. I'll take--
You just take care of her, okay?
I haven't seen one of these in years. Look at this.
Jade! Hey, where are the wires?
The extra wires from the radio tower! Where are they?
Jade, where are the fuckin' wires?
I-It's out in the shed! Come on. Come on! Go!
What the fuck-- what-- What the fuck is this?
Look, there was a problem at the settlement.
Okay, help, help, help move him.
Come on. Yeah, ready? Yeah, one, two, three.
I promise, I'll explain everything later.
Donna needs your help. Get your shit together.
What's going on in there? Is she gonna be okay?
Why is everyone standing by Donna's room?
But she's okay, right? Is she okay?
Everyone's doing whatever they can. Hey--
But she was fine. Is it because of the settlement?
honey, sometimes things like this just happen to people.
I wanna see her before she dies.
Hey. Don't say that. She's not gonna die.
Yes, she is. Everyone here dies.
Just let me say goodbye. Please.
Well, her vitals are really stable,
Okay. Then why isn't she awake?
Well, we just don't know how long
her brain's been deprived of oxygen for.
Tabitha's asking if she could bring Ethan in here
Uh, yeah, just for a second though.
I won't forget what you said.
That fear is what makes us heroes.
I promise I'll always do my best to be brave.
That doesn't get any better, does it?
And that, it seems, is the end of that.
I say we go for bottle number two.
My dear, I cannot find it in my heart to disagree.
I can-- I-I can get it.

I'm sorry. I didn't-- I didn't mean to pry.
No, it's all right, it's just...
the man who wore that suit.
He did things. To my family.
He came here with my wife and daughter...

I say we drink to your family.
There has to be something around here

I'm gonna make food for everyone up at Colony House.
I'd almost forgotten what it was like.

I had a real sweet tooth.

Oh. I was more partial to gummy worms.
that my dad used to take me-- this doughnut shop--

you understood what I went through.
that I could still help my dad.

not cut off my fingers for a pot of your stew.

that me, Abby, and Ellis rolled into town?

and this lady is talking about snoring.

Right there in the middle of all the fear,
little voice in the back of my head said, "This one--
yeah, she knows how to survive.

and she's the one that got me through it.
